message.content:
**Typical Lasagna Ingredients**

| Category | Common Items |
|----------|--------------|
| **Noodles** | Lasagna sheets (no-boil or regular) |
| **Meat** | Ground beef, pork, or a mix; optional sausage |
| **Sauce** | Tomato sauce or marinara; add crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, or a béchamel (white sauce) |
| **Cheeses** | Ricotta (or cottage cheese), shredded mozzarella, grated Parmesan |
| **Vegetables** | Onion, garlic, spinach, mushrooms, zucchini, bell pepper (optional) |
| **Seasonings & Herbs** | Salt, black pepper, dried basil, dried oregano, red‑pepper flakes, fresh parsley or basil |
| **Extras** | Egg (for binding ricotta mixture), olive oil, butter (for béchamel), milk or cream (for béchamel) |

Feel free to adjust quantities and add your favorite extras—lasagna is highly customizable!
